role: English source copy for the Help Center's core categories (Getting Started, Recording, Your Recovery Score) and the HelpContent entry points that assemble all 12 categories, localized or English.
types: HelpContent: enum (@MainActor) — categories/englishCategories plus static category constants gettingStarted, recording, recoveryScore (others in HelpContent+Articles.swift)
toplevel: Three static-let HelpCategory constants built once (theme colours AppTheme.softGold/primary/sage). Articles: what-is-flow-recovery, your-first-reading, building-your-baseline, devices-setup; extended-recording, quick-reading, split-sleep, data-quality; understanding-score, score-tiers, comeback-mode, vitals-and-feedback, analysis-window. Copy states numeric product rules (HRV 60/Sleep 25/Vitals 15, Tier2 70/30, comeback 80/20/0 for 21 days, SpO2 <95% 24h average = -10, merge window 4.5 h default 1-12 h custom, paused-battery <=5% finalises, Tier-1 adjustments CV<2% -5 / >12% -3, DFA +5/-5/-3, ANS -6/-3/+2, stale baseline -5 per week to -20). Spot-checked against code: merge window (UserSettings+Model.swift:40, UserSettings+Codable.swift:77), paused battery <=5 (RRCollector+Bindings.swift:203), Tier-1 constants (Constants+RecoveryScore.swift:27-75); several others are pinned by HelpScienceAccuracyTests/HelpContentAccuracyTests. Code comments at lines 376-387 and 455-460 record that the vitals sub-score is an unweighted average and there is no HR-dip sub-score.

units.does: Returns englishCategories(forAge:) with every category passed through HelpCategory.localized (translated into the app language); the only production caller is HelpCenterView.categories (HelpCenterView.swift:19), which re-runs it on every access including every search keystroke.

Returns the 12 Help categories in display order: gettingStarted, recording, recoveryScore, HelpScienceCatalog.sleepAnalysis/trainingLoad/vitals, HelpScienceCatalog.hrvScience(forAge:) (age-personalised), then aiAssistant, getMeBack, yourData, personalization, appNavigation from HelpContent+Articles.swift; all English. Called by categories and by tests (HelpContentAccuracyTests, HelpScienceAccuracyTests, ProviderModelCatalogTests).
